energy_mixed_curvature.energies: total PBE+D3(BJ) energies in a common anchor/pair/scale panel
energy_mixed_curvature.periodic_coordinates: signed displacements are wrapped to (-pi,pi] before division

gradient_secant_curvature.jacobian: J_i,a = partial q_i / partial R_a, evaluated at each labeled geometry with the exact coordinate definitions
gradient_secant_curvature.internal_gradient_projection: g_q = pinv(J^T) g_R; use SVD rcond=1e-10 and persist rank/singular values/projection residual
gradient_secant_curvature.estimator: symmetric least-squares H fitted independently per anchor from that anchor's corner gradient secants; report unconstrained antisymmetric part before symmetrization

consistency_diagnostics.energy_gradient: compare H_ij^(E) with symmetric gradient/secant H_ij, including sign and propagated numerical uncertainty
consistency_diagnostics.opposite_corner_symmetry: compare + and - directional secants and retain their difference as a nonlinearity diagnostic
consistency_diagnostics.scale_stability: for MIN01 S_C/C_S_H compare full and half scale estimates before pooling
consistency_diagnostics.anchor_dependence: retain MIN01, MIN02, and MIN04 estimates separately before any aggregate

numerical_uncertainty.propagation: use independent-error root-sum-square propagation for energy corners and Jacobian-projected gradient components; report both RMS-based and conservative max-based intervals

predeclared_classification.MIXED_CURVATURE_RESOLVED: energy and gradient estimates have the same sign and their propagated 95% uncertainty intervals exclude zero and overlap
predeclared_classification.MIXED_CURVATURE_NOT_RESOLVED: both estimators are compatible with zero or their uncertainty intervals do not establish a common nonzero value
predeclared_classification.SCALE_DEPENDENT_NONLINEAR: the preregistered full/half-scale estimates are mutually incompatible under propagated 95% uncertainty or opposite-corner secants disagree beyond that uncertainty
predeclared_classification.ANCHOR_DEPENDENT: at least two anchor-specific resolved estimates are mutually incompatible under propagated 95% uncertainty; anchor-specific values remain primary
